description: Flexible rod trees (Z 20) on the CFD mesh refinement: a current (B 60 1, U = 0.375 m/s from rest) past a vertical pile D = 0.25 m (S 33) with 7 rows of soft marine growth surrogates (45 mm silicone rods, 22 per row, make_fronds.py config b), two static levels around the pile (G 1 2, G 16 / G 15, G 7 0), N 40 5, 2 ranks. The rods take the velocity of the finest patch at their points (cfd_amr::rod_sample) and their reaction goes to the faces of the patches (cfd_amr::rod_forces); the kernel weight inside the pile goes to the fluid faces; rod-pile contact (rodtree 'cylinder').
covers: momentum_forcing: rod trees on level 0 only (amr_patch)
